correctness.rationale: A strict believed-public-announcement update necessarily removes every incoming arrow to at least one currently active false target. Because relations only shrink, that target can never return, so the active-target set strictly decreases at every strict stage. This proves stabilization within |T0| rounds. The directed-cycle witness with formula p and non-dead-end status removes exactly one new target per round and attains |W|.
